scope: 164 runway-specific VOR/NDB candidates; circling-only, ILS/LOC, RNP excluded
reviewPolicy: NO NAVIGATION AUTHORIZATION. Airport elevation substitutes only when runway threshold missing. Fallback and station offsets fitted from one published fix remain QA only, not surveyed location.
rounding: 318 ft/NM at exactly 3deg, true tangent at other published angles, altitude nearest 20ft; published unchanged.
gridPolicy: Exactly 1 DME NM between consecutive rows; extend through integer DME to >=10 NM threshold distance and D10; other decimals only VDP.
vdPPolicy: Calculated intercept of geometric line with MDA, one decimal DME; not a published VDP. No VDP where MDA or geometry is unavailable.
